descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B25 · P1 · 已知

养老院 dashboard 把所有住户都算进去（22 个，应为 19 个 In Today），取消 In Today 的住户还在上面

票：TFA-92587 AC6 ready for qa；TFA-92598 in progress · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-20/S04a, TC-20/S06, TC-20/S07

思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S09 「In Today × 查房状态 → 养老院 dashboard 的计数」 In Today × rounding status → Nursing Home dashboard counts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 'In Today' drives the dashboard counts: the Nursing Home Rounding Dashboard counts only the residents marked In Today. (The dashboard tabs and whether the counts follow the tab are TC-20 U3, gated on …（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 6；TFA-92587 How it works 6；TFA-92598 AC 4 (same rule)）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Fixture resident (In Today, pending) plus QA Kale (In Today, pending), QA Larch (In Today, complete), QA Maple (not In Today, pre-rounded), QA Nettle (not In Today, complete)

When Open the Nursing Home Rounding Dashboard; go back, mark QA Maple In Today from All Residents, open the dashboard again; go back, un-mark QA Kale, open the dashboard again

Then Counts cover only residents marked In Today. First Total 3 / Pending 2 / In Progress 0 / Complete 1. After marking Maple: 4 / 2 / 1 / 1. After un-marking Kale: 3 / 1 / 1 / 1. QA Nettle is never counted

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：The four numbers under 'Rounding status counts' on each checkpoint equal the expected row of the table (`counts`, same key as TC-20 S03). Judged against UAT TC-09 and TFA-92587 AC 6, which is ready for qa: a mismatch is a Fail on TFA-92587, reported as Fail (known) because the ticket snapshot already records that roundingDashboard.ts loads view 'all' on e02167f. …

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92587 ready for qa；TFA-92598 in progress

养老院 Rounding Dashboard 把所有住户都算进去（Total 22，应为 19），标记或取消 In Today 计数都不变。

The Nursing Home Rounding Dashboard counts every resident (Total 22 instead of 19), and marking or un-marking In Today does not change the counts.

依据：allure 915dd492, datasets lane marked known. A matrix knownGap sits on every check: roundingDashboard.ts loads view 'all' (TFA-92587 AC 6 / TFA-92598 AC 4, Q4). Also dev report §4 bullet 1, and ledger U57 (same on dev) and U69.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。
